headline: Two managers, one warehouse — FLOOR BOSS gets a rival
lede: DUEL seats put the studio's own autopilot at a second manager seat beside you. One floor, one budget, two scoreboards: every stow, parcel and freight bonus credits the manager whose asset earned it, and the whistle names MANAGER OF THE NIGHT.

notes.text: DUEL mode ships for FLOOR BOSS: press D at the attract and the model manager clocks in — its own cyan cursor, its own racks, its own till. Credit follows work on three laws (stow to the rack owner, escrow to the parcel shipper, freight per box); the richer till takes the night.

The solo floor is bit-identical: a tick-for-tick parity gate proves the duel overlay never nudges the economy, so the autopilot's quota proof transfers to either seat. A conservation invariant (score = 100 + credits − spent) closes every tick of every duel, Node and browser.

floorbosscheck gained 17 duel gates and a mutant kill (--mutate-duel: bot stows paying the house goes red). floorbossplay drives a live duel end to end — 41/41. Episodes finally record players:2, sources ['human','model'].

Ladder note: slot b took the never-dry rung — LodeRunnerLite's vault witness stayed with slot a (live hold), the flagship gaps are spent, and weakestStage named FLOOR BOSS with two unowned README gaps. The turn-radii gap stays open and queued.
